description:
I am a security-focused Cloud Engineer and Systems Administrator at Tyche Insights, and a Digital Forensics and Cybersecurity Masters student at UAlbany. I am passionate about leveraging technology to solve real-world problems and keep data safe. At Tyche I designed, deployed, and secured a greenfield AWS environment, and I handle Linux hardening, patch management, monitoring, and security audits mapped to CIS benchmarks.
My educational background in Networking and Cybersecurity, combined with hands-on experience in a variety of roles, has equipped me with a versatile skill set in cloud security, programming, web technologies, and system tools. My professional journey includes internships where I honed my abilities in threat monitoring automation and geospatial data quality control, and I hold the CompTIA Security+ and ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity certifications.
I thrive on learning and mastering new skills, whether it is repairing cameras, developing full-stack applications on Raspberry Pi, or learning to develop and shoot film photography. From building a Software Bill of Materials application to designing a Wireless Sensor Node, I am constantly seeking opportunities to challenge myself and grow.
skills: AWS (IAM, ECR, Lambda, EC2, S3, Security Groups, CloudTrail)
